suspect:gregor_veronese: Gregor Veronese adjusted his cufflinks before answering. His Italian was flawless but his pauses came at odd intervals.
event:champagne_compound: The champagne carried a faint bitter note beneath the bubbles. The compound dissolved without changing the colour.
motive:double_agent_exposure: The coded dispatches would reach London by morning. Once deciphered, the name behind the substitution key would be finished.
suspect:marguerite_devaux: Marguerite Devaux stood near the orchids with her glass untouched. Her argument with Poel had ended ten minutes before the intermission.
suspect:sergeant_linden: Sergeant Linden kept one hand on his radio and the other at his side. His log showed continuous entries except for twelve minutes.
suspect:commander_holt: Commander Holt asked about Baltic frequencies over the second course. His napkin was folded into quarters and placed on the left.
suspect:daniil_orlov: Daniil Orlov carried his camera openly, as press credentials allow. The lens cap was off during the aperitif hour.
suspect:henri_maes: Henri Maes polished each glass with a linen cloth before service. His apron pocket bulged with two small stoppered vials.
suspect:eva_brandt: Eva Brandt transferred from the Vienna office six weeks before the reception. Her personnel file arrived three days after she did.
location:belgian_embassy: The Belgian Embassy stands behind an iron gate on a tree-lined avenue. The fog pressed against the windows by eight o'clock.
location:conservatory: The conservatory opens off the east wing through a glass door. Fern fronds brushed the ceiling and the tiles were damp.
location:east_corridor: The east corridor connects the reception hall to the service wing. The carpet shows two sets of footprints in opposite directions.
location:reception_hall: Crystal chandeliers lit the reception hall in warm tones. The guest book lay open on a marble stand by the entrance.
location:cipher_office: The cipher office occupied a windowless room on the second floor. A desk lamp burned and the waste bin was empty.
location:service_pantry: The service pantry held three trolleys and a wall of glassware. A drawer beneath the counter was not fully closed.
location:embassy_garden: The garden path curved behind the conservatory toward the gate. Frost had settled on the bench and the gravel was quiet.
location:attache_suite: The attache suite was locked but the key hung on the corridor peg. A leather case sat open on the writing desk.
object:champagne_flute: A champagne flute rested beside the body, half-full. The lipstick on the rim did not match any female guest.
object:cipher_ledger: Poel's cipher ledger lay open to page thirteen. Pages fourteen through seventeen had been torn out along the spine.
object:torn_pages: Four charred page fragments sat in the conservatory fireplace. The ink survived enough to show column headers and partial numbers.
object:coded_dispatch: A folded sheet was found in Veronese's jacket lining. The text used a letter-shift cipher and referenced three dates in November.
object:vial_residue: A glass fragment the size of a thumbnail lay under the service trolley. The inner surface carried a crystalline residue.
object:guest_register: The guest register showed forty-one signatures in blue and black ink. Veronese signed at 19:42 in a slanting hand.
object:radio_log: The security radio log records transmissions at four-minute intervals. Between 20:15 and 20:27 the page is blank.
object:photograph_roll: Orlov's camera held a roll of thirty-six exposures. Frames nine through fourteen showed the cipher ledger from above.
object:embassy_key: A brass key to the conservatory was found in the steward's trouser pocket. The teeth showed fresh scratch marks.
object:glove_powder: White residue covered three fingers of Marguerite's evening gloves. Laboratory analysis identified it as blackboard chalk.
object:service_tray: The champagne tray held eight crystal positions in a brass frame. One position showed a ring stain but no glass.
object:diplomatic_pouch: A sealed courier pouch sat in Veronese's leather case. The wax showed a double impression where the seal had been lifted.
object:frequency_list: A handwritten list of Baltic radio frequencies was found in Poel's desk. The paper matched the stock used in the cipher office.
emotion:measured_calm: His breathing did not change when the body was mentioned. The champagne in his hand remained level.
emotion:averted_gaze: She turned toward the orchids when the inspector approached. Her fingers tightened on the stem of her glass.
emotion:rigid_posture: The steward stood with both arms at his sides during questioning. His collar was damp but his voice did not waver.
emotion:careful_phrasing: Each answer arrived after a pause of exactly two seconds. The words were chosen as if from a prepared list.
emotion:delayed_reaction: She heard the name and continued writing for three full seconds. The pen stopped mid-stroke on the fourth.
emotion:feigned_concern: He asked twice whether the doctor had been summoned. His eyes moved to the corridor door each time.
modifier:lipstick_mismatch: The lipstick shade on the glass did not appear on any guest. The colour was a discontinued Belgian brand.
modifier:tampered_seal: The diplomatic pouch seal showed two overlapping impressions. The wax had been softened and re-pressed with the same ring.
modifier:glass_missing: One position on the service tray was empty with a wet ring. The missing glass was not among those collected.
modifier:burned_fragments: The fireplace held fragments of four pages, curled and blackened. One corner preserved the word 'frequencies' in Poel's hand.
modifier:fog_thickness: Visibility outside the embassy dropped to fifteen metres after eight. The gate guard could not see the garden bench.
modifier:corridor_locked: The east corridor door was locked from the service side at 20:10. The key hung on a hook beside the pantry.
modifier:substitution_cipher: The coded dispatch used a letter-shift of seven positions. The same shift appeared in two intercepted messages from October.
modifier:fresh_ink: The ink on the dispatch was still tacky when examined at 21:00. The paper had been written within the previous three hours.
modifier:wax_impression: The wax bore the imprint of a signet ring with a laurel motif. Veronese wore such a ring on his left hand.
modifier:chalk_residue: The chalk on Marguerite's gloves matched the blackboard in the embassy classroom. She had tutored French that afternoon.
action:pages_torn: Four pages were torn from the spine with force. The remaining stubs showed uneven edges and traces of haste.
action:glass_switched: One champagne glass was removed from the tray before the toast. A second glass, prepared earlier, was placed in its position.
action:corridor_crossed: Two sets of footprints crossed the east corridor carpet. One set matched leather soles and the other matched rubber.
action:dispatch_concealed: The coded dispatch was folded into the jacket lining through an interior seam. The stitching had been opened and re-sewn.
action:camera_confiscated: Orlov's camera was confiscated at the garden entrance by Sergeant Linden. The film had already been advanced past frame fourteen.
action:toast_raised: The ambassador raised the first toast at 20:08. All guests stood and the steward circulated with the tray.
action:pouch_opened: The diplomatic pouch was opened without breaking the outer strap. The wax seal was the only barrier and it had been compromised.
action:ledger_photographed: Frames nine through fourteen on the film show the cipher ledger. The angle is consistent with the cipher office desk.
action:vial_discarded: A small glass vial was dropped beneath the service trolley. The stopper was missing and the interior was dry.
time:intermission_hour: The intermission began at 20:30 and was scheduled for twenty minutes. The body was found at 20:41.
time:fog_descended: Fog settled over the avenue at approximately 19:50. By the time of the toast, the garden was invisible from the windows.
time:guest_arrival: Guests began arriving at 19:00 and the last signature was recorded at 19:58. The doors were sealed for security after eight.
time:radio_gap: The security radio logged no transmissions between 20:15 and 20:27. Sergeant Linden stated he was checking the east corridor.
time:body_found: A kitchen porter entered the conservatory at 20:41 to retrieve a tray. The body was seated upright in a wicker chair.
motive:cipher_seizure: Poel had decoded three dispatches that referenced an internal source. The source was identified by a codename matching Veronese's frequency.
motive:diplomatic_leverage: Commander Holt sought leverage over the Belgian cipher operation. Access to the frequency list would give London a significant advantage.
motive:handler_payment: Bank records in Vienna showed monthly deposits to an unnumbered account. The amounts matched the schedule of Eastern dispatches.
motive:career_protection: Eva Brandt's transfer from Vienna coincided with a leak investigation. Her clearance was provisional and under quarterly review.
motive:blackmail_pressure: A letter in Poel's desk referenced an unnamed diplomat whose cover was expiring. The tone was urgent and the handwriting was Poel's.
witness:wine_steward: The wine steward carried four trays between the pantry and the hall. He passed the conservatory door twice and heard nothing.
witness:coat_check_girl: The coat check girl noted arrival times in a small notebook. She recorded Veronese at 19:41, one minute before the register.
witness:gate_guard: The gate guard locked the entrance at 20:02 and did not reopen it. He saw no one leave through the garden after the fog.
witness:kitchen_porter: The kitchen porter entered the conservatory to collect a drinks tray. He found the man seated and still, with the glass beside him.
witness:driver: The embassy driver waited in the forecourt until 22:00. He saw Sergeant Linden cross the garden at approximately 20:20.
event:aldric_poel_discovered: Aldric Poel was found seated in the conservatory during the intermission. His champagne glass was half-full and his eyes were closed.
event:intermission_recess: During the intermission, guests moved between the hall and the corridor. The conservatory was accessible through an unlocked glass door.
